question: Should document-bound existing-session predicate waits fail closed unless the server reports the verified chrome_devtools 1.5.0 contract?
rationale: The policy closes a real model-code execution boundary but intentionally removes predicate-wait availability from unreviewed custom and upgraded Chrome MCP servers.

options.title: Accept the verified pinned guard
options.body: Port the implementation to current main and merge after live evidence confirms approved waits and denied replacement-document blocking.

options.title: Require a capability-based gate
options.body: Replace exact-version matching with a maintainer-approved explicit capability handshake or verified runtime contract.

options.title: Pause for an upstream API
options.body: Hold document-bound predicate waits until Chrome MCP exposes a stable document-identity capability.

recommendation.title: Accept the verified pinned guard
recommendation.body: Port the implementation to current main and merge after live evidence confirms approved waits and denied replacement-document blocking.
